name: tmcp
description: Compile small task-specific operating packets for complex implementation, migration, debugging, architecture, documentation, verification, and review work.

interface.shortDescription: Compile focused operating packets when task complexity justifies them.
interface.longDescription: TMCP is an admission-controlled task compiler. It identifies complex implementation, migration, debugging, architecture, documentation, verification, and explicit review work; selects a small source-backed operating packet; and recompiles only after material runtime changes. Specialized audit and rubric skills remain explicit routes and provenance sources rather than the default product surface.
defaultPrompt: Use TMCP to implement this backend API with verification gates.
Use TMCP to plan and execute this database migration safely.
Use TMCP to debug this regression and preserve the passing behavior.
Use TMCP to make this architecture decision and trace compatibility impacts.
Use TMCP to update the implementation and its documentation together.
Use TMCP to prepare this release and identify missing evidence.
Use TMCP in shadow mode to evaluate whether composition helps this task.
Use the explicit TMCP audit route to review this system.
Explain TMCP's admission decision and packet for this task.
Run tmcp_doctor and verify this install.
Harvest this repo's production guidance into a TMCP packet.
Recommend TMCP workflows from this repo's skill signals.
